Every set we make

The seven

Each set is ten nails on one idea, made in a small run and packed with twelve sizes so it fits without a fitting. Nothing here is printed or bought in.

  • Lily Blanc

    kr 420

    Glazed milk

    A translucent milk base under a glazed top coat, each nail drawn with a single lily in white on white. The quietest set we make.

    View the set

  • Orchid Veil

    kr 440

    Aurora pearl

    Blush pink pressed thin enough to read the nail beneath, with an aurora pearl that pulls lilac in daylight and peach under lamps.

    View the set

  • Matcha Latte

    kr 440

    Satin marble

    Sage folded into warm cream and left to marble, no two nails alike. Finished satin, so it reads matte until the light catches it.

    View the set

  • Cherry Gloss

    kr 460

    Jelly gloss

    Layered translucent red until it holds depth like glass. The gloss is the whole point — it stays wet-looking for the life of the set.

    View the set

  • Étoile

    kr 520

    Mirror chrome

    A mirror chrome that borrows the colour of whatever room you walk into, with crystals set by hand into small four-point stars.

    View the set

  • Bunny Cream

    kr 460

    Glazed pearl

    A milky nude with a glazed-doughnut sheen, and on two nails a rabbit the size of a grain of rice wearing a blush bow.

    View the set

  • Amour

    kr 540

    Jelly crimson

    Ten nails on one theme — hearts poured in jelly red, a soda bottle and a love letter built up in relief, and a gingham bow sculpted by hand.

    View the set
